```{r, echo=TRUE}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#  Define score columns

cols_obj <- grep("Scoreobj", colnames(CSSScores), value = TRUE)
cols_subj <- grep("Scoresubj", colnames(CSSScores), value = TRUE)


# Ensure numeric columns

CSSScores <- CSSScores %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_obj), as.numeric),
         across(all_of(cols_subj), as.numeric))


# Compute mean score per patient

patient_means <- CSSScores %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_obj  = mean(c_across(all_of(cols_obj)), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_subj = mean(c_across(all_of(cols_subj)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(sid, mean_obj, mean_subj) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_obj, mean_subj),
               names_to = "Type",
               values_to = "MeanScore") %>%
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Type == "mean_obj", "Objective", "Subjective"))


#Boxplot comparing mean scores per patient

ggplot(patient_means, aes(x = Type, y = MeanScore, fill = Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.01), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +  # show individual patient points
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Objective" = "lightgreen", "Subjective" = "lightpink")) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Mean CSS Scores",
       x = "Score Type",
       y = "Mean CSS Score") +
  theme_minimal()


# Prepare density data

# Objective scores
df_obj <- CSSScores %>%
  select(all_of(cols_obj)) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID,
               names_to = "Visit",
               values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Objective")

# Subjective scores
df_subj <- CSSScores %>%
  select(all_of(cols_subj)) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ID,
               names_to = "Visit",
               values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Subjective")

# Combine
df_all <- bind_rows(df_obj, df_subj)


# Density plot

ggplot(df_all, aes(x = Score, color = Type, fill = Type)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Objective" = "lightgreen", "Subjective" = "lightpink")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Objective" = "lightgreen", "Subjective" = "lightpink")) +
  xlim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Density of CSS Scores",
       x = "CSS severity level",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
# Transform CSSScores to long format for all visits combined
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

data_long <- CSSScores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sid,
    names_to = c("Visit", "Type"),
    names_pattern = "V(\\d+)_(Scoreobj|Scoresubj)",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  
  # If there are multiple values per sid/Visit/Type, take the mean
  group_by(sid, Visit, Type) %>%
  summarise(Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Score) %>%
  mutate(
    mean = (Scoreobj + Scoresubj)/2,
    diff = Scoreobj - Scoresubj
  )
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
#Classic Bland Altman for all visits combined

library(ggplot2)

# Bias, SD of differences and limits of agreement for all visits combined
mean_diff <- mean(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96 * sd_diff
upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96 * sd_diff

#bland altman plot for all visits combined
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = mean, y = diff, color = sid)) +
  geom_count(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-8, 8), xlim = c(0, 8)) +

scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 8, 1)) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 8, 1))  +
  labs(
    title = "Classic Bland-Altman for all visits combined",
    x = "Scores Mean (Obj & Subj)",
    y = "Scores differences (Obj - Subj)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#number of observations and complete cases for mean and diff
nrow(data_long)

sum(complete.cases(data_long$mean, data_long$diff))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
#non parametric bland Altman with ggplot for all visits combined
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# calcul non paramétrique
ba_np <- data_long %>%
  mutate(diff = Scoreobj - Scoresubj,
         mean = (Scoreobj + Scoresubj)/2) %>%
  summarise(
    median_diff = median(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower_limit = quantile(diff, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper_limit = quantile(diff, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# plot avec ggplot
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = (Scoreobj + Scoresubj)/2, y = Scoreobj - Scoresubj)) +
  geom_count(aes(color = sid), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ba_np$median_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ba_np$lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ba_np$upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = 0:8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-8, 8), breaks = seq(-8, 8, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Nonparametric Bland-Altman Plot (all visits combined)",
    x = "Mean score (objective and subjective)",
    y = "Score difference (objective - subjective)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
#Bland Altman with random effects for all visits combined
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Fit a mixed-effects model on the differences (random intercept per patient)
model_re <- lmer(diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid), data = data_long)

# Extract the fixed effect (overall mean difference = bias)
mean_diff_re <- fixef(model_re)[1]

# Extract variance components (between-subject and within-subject variability)
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_re))
var_between <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "sid"]
var_within <- attr(VarCorr(model_re), "sc")^2

# Compute total standard deviation
sd_total <- sqrt(var_between + var_within)

# Compute limits of agreement
lower_limit_re <- mean_diff_re - 1.96 * sd_total
upper_limit_re <- mean_diff_re + 1.96 * sd_total

# Plot Bland-Altman with random effects
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = mean, y = diff, color = sid)) +
  geom_count(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff_re, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit_re, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit_re, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-8, 8), xlim = c(0, 8)) +

scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 8, 1)) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 8, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Bland-Altman Plot with Random Effects for all visits combined",
    x = "Mean score (objective and subjective)",
    y = "Score difference (objective - subjective)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)

# Fit a mixed-effects model on the differences (random intercept per patient)
model_re <- lmer(diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid), data = data_long)

# Extract the fixed effect (overall mean difference = bias)
mean_diff_re <- fixef(model_re)[1]


# Define the minimal clinical threshold (instead of 1.96*SD)
clinical_threshold <- 2.5

# Compute Bland-Altman limits using the clinical threshold
lower_limit_clinical <- mean_diff_re - clinical_threshold
upper_limit_clinical <- mean_diff_re + clinical_threshold

# Classic Bland-Altman limits (±1.96 SD)
sd_diff <- sd(data_long$diff)
lower_limit_sd <- mean_diff_re - 1.96 * sd_diff
upper_limit_sd <- mean_diff_re + 1.96 * sd_diff

# Clinical threshold (SRD)
threshold <- 2.5

# Total number of observations
n_total <- nrow(data_long)

# Number of observations outside the acceptable range (±2.5)
n_outside <- sum(abs(data_long$diff) > threshold)

# Percentage outside the acceptable range
pct_outside <- (n_outside / n_total) * 100

# Breakdown: negative vs positive differences
n_negative <- sum(data_long$diff < -threshold)
n_positive <- sum(data_long$diff > threshold)

pct_negative <- (n_negative / n_total) * 100
pct_positive <- (n_positive / n_total) * 100

# Display results
pct_outside
pct_negative
pct_positive


# Plot Bland-Altman with clinical threshold
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = mean, y = diff, color = sid)) +
  geom_count(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff_re, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
 
  # Use clinical threshold for lower and upper limits
geom_hline(yintercept = -2.5, color = "green", linetype = "solid") +
geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, color = "green", linetype = "solid") +
  
  # 1.96 SD limits 
geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit_sd, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit_sd, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-8, 8), xlim = c(0, 8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 8, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 8, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Bland-Altman Plot with clinical threshold of ±2.5",
    x = "Mean score (objective and subjective)",
    y = "Score difference (objective - subjective)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
# Comparative table for all Bland-Altman methods
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)

# Initialize empty data frame to store results
ba_results <- data.frame(
  Method = character(),
  Bias = numeric(),
  Lower_LoA = numeric(),
  Upper_LoA = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 1. Classical Bland-Altman

mean_diff_classic <- mean(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff_classic <- sd(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_classic <- mean_diff_classic - 1.96 * sd_diff_classic
upper_classic <- mean_diff_classic + 1.96 * sd_diff_classic

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Classical (parametric)",
    Bias = mean_diff_classic,
    Lower_LoA = lower_classic,
    Upper_LoA = upper_classic
  )


# 2. Nonparametric Bland-Altman

ba_np <- data_long %>%
  mutate(diff = Scoreobj - Scoresubj,
         mean = (Scoreobj + Scoresubj)/2) %>%
  summarise(
    median_diff = median(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower_limit = quantile(diff, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper_limit = quantile(diff, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Nonparametric",
    Bias = ba_np$median_diff,
    Lower_LoA = ba_np$lower_limit,
    Upper_LoA = ba_np$upper_limit
  )


# 3. Bland-Altman with Random Effects

# Mixed-effects model on diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid)
model_re <- lmer(diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid), data = data_long)
mean_diff_re <- fixef(model_re)[1]
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_re))
var_between <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "sid"]
var_within <- attr(VarCorr(model_re), "sc")^2
sd_total <- sqrt(var_between + var_within)
lower_re <- mean_diff_re - 1.96 * sd_total
upper_re <- mean_diff_re + 1.96 * sd_total

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Random Effects",
    Bias = mean_diff_re,
    Lower_LoA = lower_re,
    Upper_LoA = upper_re
  )


# 4. Bland-Altman with Clinical Threshold ±2.5

clinical_threshold <- 2.5
lower_clinical <- mean_diff_re - clinical_threshold
upper_clinical <- mean_diff_re + clinical_threshold

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Clinical Threshold ±2.5",
    Bias = mean_diff_re,
    Lower_LoA = lower_clinical,
    Upper_LoA = upper_clinical
  )


# Display comparative table

ba_results %>% 
  arrange(Method)

#table for publication

library(knitr)

ba_results %>%
  arrange(Method) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 2,                  # rounded to 2 decimal places
    col.names = c("Method", "Bias", "Lower Limit", "Upper Limit"),
    caption = "Comparison of methods Bland-Altman"
  )
```

```{r Cohen, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#Cohen's Kappa for pain only
library(dplyr)
library(irr)

# Initialize dataframe for stock results
kappa_results <- data.frame()

# Visit lists
visits <- paste0("v", 1:20) 

for(v in visits){

  # Caregiver = "_cssdoul", Patient = "_css2"
  col_soignant <- paste0(v, "_cssdoul")
  col_patient  <- paste0(v, "_css2")

  # Check if columns exist to avoid errors
  if(all(c(col_soignant, col_patient) %in% colnames(CSSA))){
    
    # check variations to avoid NaNs
    vals <- CSSA[, c(col_soignant, col_patient)]
    if(length(unique(vals[[1]])) > 1 && length(unique(vals[[2]])) > 1){
      k <- kappa2(vals)
      kappa_results <- rbind(kappa_results,
                             data.frame(visit = v,
                                        kappa = k$value,
                                        z = k$statistic,
                                        p = k$p.value))
    } else {
      kappa_results <- rbind(kappa_results,
                             data.frame(visit = v,
                                        kappa = NA,
                                        z = NA,
                                        p = NA))
    }
  }
}

print (kappa_results)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#Cohen's kappa for all items
library(dplyr)
library(irr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define mapping of items to columns (soignant = clinician, patient = patient)
item_map <- list(
  Pain      = c("cssdoul", "css2"),
  Hyperalgesia = c("csshypall", "css3"),
  Temperature  = c("csstemp", "css4"),
  Erythema     = c("csseryth", "css5"),
  Sweating     = c("csssud", "css6"),
  Edema       = c("cssoed", "css7"),
  Trophicity   = c("csstroph", "css8"),
  Strength        = c("cssforcemoy", "css9")
)

# All visits
visits <- paste0("v", 1:20) 

# Initialize results dataframe
kappa_results <- data.frame()

# Loop through each item and each visit
for(item_name in names(item_map)){
  cols <- item_map[[item_name]]  # clinician and patient columns
  for(v in visits){
    clinician_col <- grep(paste0("^", v, "_", cols[1], "$"), colnames(CSSA), value = TRUE)
    patient_col   <- grep(paste0("^", v, "_", cols[2], "$"), colnames(CSSA), value = TRUE)
    
    if(length(clinician_col) == 1 & length(patient_col) == 1){
      k <- kappa2(CSSA[, c(clinician_col, patient_col)])
      kappa_results <- rbind(kappa_results,
                             data.frame(
                               item  = item_name,
                               visit = v,
                               kappa = k$value,
                               z     = k$statistic,
                               p     = k$p.value
                             ))
    }
  }
}

kappa_results
```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
#transform visit in numeric for plotting
kappa_results$visit <- factor(kappa_results$visit, levels = paste0("v", 1:20))

# Plot Cohen's Kappa over time for each item
# Fix order of visits
kappa_results$visit <- factor(kappa_results$visit, levels = paste0("v", 1:20))

# Plot
ggplot(kappa_results, aes(x = visit, y = kappa, group = item, color = item)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Inter-rater Agreement (Cohen's Kappa) per Item",
       x = "Visit", y = "Cohen's Kappa")

# Compute average Kappa per item if stable over time
kappa_avg <- kappa_results %>%
   filter(item != "Strength") %>%  
  group_by(item) %>%
  summarize(mean_kappa = mean(kappa, na.rm = TRUE))

kappa_avg


#average plot
ggplot(kappa_avg, aes(x = reorder(item, mean_kappa), y = mean_kappa, fill = item)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Cohen's Kappa per Item",
       x = "Item CSS",
       y = "Mean Kappa") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
